title: Borrowing Costs
summary: Requires borrowing costs directly attributable to the acquisition, construction or production of a qualifying asset to be capitalised as part of the asset's cost, converged almost exactly with IAS 23.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS – Closely Converged with IAS 23
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 23 reproduces IAS 23's mandatory borrowing cost capitalisation model for qualifying assets almost exactly, with no substantive divergence. Its Indian practical relevance is prominent for infrastructure/real estate developers with extended construction periods. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
